description: Check TLS certificate expiry, chain, key size and offered protocol versions, including STARTTLS services
notes: Requires Python 3 on PATH (python.org installer with .py file association, or `scoop install python`). Run: tls-cert-watchdog --help. Changelog: https://github.com/CanuteTheGreat/tls-cert-watchdog/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md
